name: GOST
config: CLI arguments text (passed inline as the core argument)
note: Multi-protocol tunnel & proxy. Config text = full gost args, e.g. `-L tcp://:10809 -F relay+wss://user:pass@host:443`

name: Chisel
note: TCP/UDP tunnel over HTTP/WS. e.g. `client --keepalive 25s https://host:8080 socks:127.0.0.1:10808`

name: OpenSSH
note: Dynamic SOCKS5 via SSH. e.g. `-N -D 127.0.0.1:10808 -p 22 user@host`

name: sshpass
note: sshpass wrapper for password auth, e.g. `sshpass -p PASS ssh -N -D 127.0.0.1:10808 user@host`

name: EasyTier
note: P2P virtual LAN mesh. e.g. `-i 10.144.144.2 --peers tcp://host:11010 -n net -p pw`

name: Cloudflare Tunnel
note: Cloudflare Tunnel client. e.g. `access socks5 --hostname t.yourdomain.com --url 127.0.0.1:10808`
